Hi friends, it’s Sherrod Brown. I just asked Gabby if I could share an update about my race for the U.S. Senate in Ohio with you.
At the start of the summer, a _Fox News_ poll showed me 8 points ahead of Republican Jon Husted in Ohio. I took this poll with a grain of salt – but still, we were clearly surging ahead in a race that many people once thought was a long shot.
But over the past couple of months, the lies, attacks, and money have ramped up significantly. National Republicans are spending $162 million to defeat me – on top of $3.6 million from tech billionaire Peter Thiel –** and now, a recent poll shows me trailing Husted by 3 points.**
If you thought that the momentum was definitively on our side, this is your wake-up call.
Because what we really have to pay attention to is not just each individual poll, but the polling average of this race. _Right now, it shows me at 47.8% and Husted at 47.2%._
**This race is too close for comfort, and again and again, we’re well within the margin of error. Unless we have the resources to fight back against the GOP and surge ahead, Ohio could have another two years of Jon Husted, and the GOP could stay in control of the Senate until 2029.**
But here’s the good news:
Folks like you have the power to change the outcome of this election and the future of our country.**But it only works if we all get involved.**
The single best thing you can do today to help us flip this seat and take back the Senate from the GOP is make a donation to our grassroots campaign. This is the most competitive and most consequential race in the country, and it will come down to resources. So I’m personally asking:
[**Will you split a donation between my campaign and GIFFORDS PAC today?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-brown-2026.VLItMQ&refcode=em260919-2-b&t=2&akid=11838%2E3935704%2EBkwVIX)

name: Ryan Grim
subject: Drop Site readers showed up
body:
In just a few hours, we've raised the remaining $50,000 needed to support Drop Site contributor Huda Skaik's journey from Gaza to the University of London.

| |
---|---|---
|
# Drop Site readers showed up
### In just a few hours, we've raised the remaining $50,000 needed to support Drop Site contributor Huda Skaik's journey from Gaza to the University of London.
| | | [Nika Soon-Shiong](https://substack.com/@nikasoonshiong)
---
| Sep 19
---
| [](https://substack.com/@nikasoonshiong)
---
Earlier today, we sent you an email asking you to support Drop Site contributor Huda Skaik's journey from Gaza to the University of London.
In just a few hours, we met our goal of $50,000.
Thanks to an extraordinary response from our readers, Huda now has funding to cover her remaining two years of study and will meet the financial requirements of the UK visa process. She wrote:
> "I'm deeply grateful for this opportunity to finally study journalism and experience university life after such a long interruption to my education, and after having to study online due to the ongoing genocide and its aftermath.
> Journalism has shaped me, built me, and given me a reason to keep going. It means so much to me, and it has helped me continue telling stories and being a voice for people whose voices deserve to be heard. I'm especially glad that my voice and my writing have already travelled such long distances before I ever could.
> Thank you for helping make it possible for me to take this next step -- to study, to keep writing, and hopefully to build a life where I can continue doing what I love and what I always wish to."
We'll keep the fundraiser open until Wednesday, September 23. Every additional dollar raised will help with the costs of beginning her studies and building a new life in London.
[Donate to support Huda](https://substack.com/redirect/a745fe57-5f18-467c-a82a-dadcd76ef697?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec6dfb1-eb8e-44ce-8133-e05811e1cc06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We also hope you'll consider supporting our ongoing Gaza Journalist Fund, launched last year to help 29 Palestinian journalists cover the costs of shelter, transportation, and basic needs.
Please donate and share the campaign link: [gazafund.dropsitenews.com](https://substack.com/redirect/9e3ee5c5-43ed-49bc-8a77-f22e83eb866f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Our Palestinian colleagues have continued to document the genocide of their people under impossible conditions. We remain guided by the final message of Hossam Shabat: "Do not stop speaking about Gaza. Do not let the world look away."
[Donate to the Gaza Journalist Fund](https://substack.com/redirect/9e3ee5c5-43ed-49bc-8a77-f22e83eb866f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Alongside their donations, supporters' recent messages remind us of what's possible when the community that has formed around Drop Site comes together. As one donor wrote: "Keep the light bright and the message loud."
Thank you.
Nika and the Drop Site team
(C) 2026 Drop Site News, Inc.
Drop Site News Inc., 1930 18th St NW
Ste B2 #1034, Washington, DC 20009

| Fox News agrees with us now
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3155%2E259176%2EeLNZ_o) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3155%2E259176%2EeLNZ_o)_

Hey Peter,

Let's run through the tape real quick:

**The first major play:** I won our primary and became the official Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in Iowa.

**The next key move:** Cook Political Report moved Iowa in our direction, citing my strength as a candidate and the energy we've built on the ground.

Then, the big twist: _Fox News_ debuted their first 2026 Senate forecast, **and they rate Iowa a Toss-Up.** [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/15811?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.20_Turek-Toss-Up_B1_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON_RS2&t=4&akid=3155%2E259176%2EeLNZ_o)

---

I need to tell you about the worst 4 minutes of my life.

Last November, my neighbor's son fell off his bike. Hard.

Head wound. Blood everywhere. The kid was screaming.

His mom was frozen in panic.

I ran over to help...

And realized I had nothing.

No pressure bandages. No trauma supplies. Just some old Band-Aids in a drawer somewhere.

I stood there, helpless, watching a 9-year-old bleed while we waited for the ambulance.

12 minutes felt like 12 hours.

The paramedic later told me: "If that cut had been 2 inches to the left, those 12 minutes could have killed him."

That's when I learned the brutal truth:

The American Red Cross reports that 59% of injury deaths could have been prevented with proper first aid BEFORE the ambulance arrived.

Read that again.

More than half of people who died from injuries would still be alive if someone nearby had been prepared.

And according to the CDC, 44% of Americans don't even have a proper first aid kit in their home.

That ends today.

I spent the last year working with combat medics and EMTs to create something different.

Not another drugstore bandage collection...

But a real trauma kit that handles serious injuries when seconds count.

The 1stHour Trauma First Aid Kit

This is what's inside:

→ Combat tourniquet (stops life-threatening bleeding in seconds)

→ Israeli trauma bandage (battlefield-proven wound compression)

→ Compressed gauze (handles deep wounds)

→ CPR rescue mask (when every breath counts)

→ EMT scissors (cuts through anything)

→ Splint roll, burn gel, emergency blanket

→ Plus 75 more military-grade items

All organized in a compact, waterproof bag.

Normally $139.

Today? Just $49.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDV9AAwAAAAAAw0z60ReODESAM6hZMNfB_QCoilz1ftem9jAwVYzMvU0itRmnQ0mrDW1NayLdfnrC1EvwXnwUcJqyfOl8Wv1uwiU_3kAzmKa5kfeiGS-
Claim Your Trauma Kit at 65% OFF

But here's the catch:

I only have 81 units left at this price.

Once they're gone, this deal disappears forever.

And honestly?

In an emergency, this kit could mean the difference between holding pressure on a wound and watching helplessly.

Between stabilizing an injury and making it worse.

Between a close call and a funeral.

You don't get a second chance to be prepared.

Grab Your Kit Now - Only 81 Left

I still think about that November day.

The kid was fine, thank God.

But I promised myself I'd never be unprepared again.

And I'm here to make sure you don't have to learn this lesson the hard way.

body:
We can’t afford to get this wrong, to move too slow or think too small
#

Peter, this week has made it clear that humanity is being faced with one of the most important challenges of the 21st century. It was also made clear that the Republican Party is completely unprepared to handle it.
Let me break it down for you:
**FIRST:** A researcher at the AI company Anthropic resigned, joining a ton of others who have stepped away out of deep concern for the direction the industry is taking.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sep26.HW03bQ&refcode=em260920-1-90&t=1&akid=4206%2E734936%2E6-S8Gm)
**THEN:** AI CEOs actually agreed with him, and asked the federal government to step in and regulate their industry.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sep26.HW03bQ&refcode=em260920-1-90&t=2&akid=4206%2E734936%2E6-S8Gm)
**NOW:** Donald Trump said no! Seriously. That’s what happened.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sep26.HW03bQ&refcode=em260920-1-90&t=3&akid=4206%2E734936%2E6-S8Gm)
The American people aren’t just afraid AI is coming for their jobs. They think their lives are at risk because that’s exactly what the people running the AI companies are telling them.
This goes beyond politics and corruption, Peter. Donald Trump and the Republican Party do not have a plan right now because they have no idea what they are dealing with. We can’t afford to get this wrong, to move too slow or think too small. And that’s why I’ve already begun working in Congress to treat this with the seriousness it deserves.
But if we’re being honest here, we know there’s no lasting solution to a problem like this if we have a Congress and a President who won’t regulate Big Tech — even when the industry asks them to..
[**If you want to see a Congress that actually tackles problems like this head on and doesn’t shrink from their own responsibilities, chip in $5 towards my work to elect the next generation of leaders. A Democratic majority will not bend the knee to Big Tech.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sep26.HW03bQ&refcode=em260920-1-90&t=4&akid=4206%2E734936%2E6-S8Gm)

---
| | Patriot,
---
The Supreme Court has spoken: mail-in ballots will continue this cycle.
States can still count properly postmarked ballots that arrive after Election Day. The system is locked in.
_That reality changes the math._
**[When more voters cast ballots by mail, the advantage goes to the side that is organized enough to follow those ballots all the way home.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDV9AAwAAAAAAw6n_I05PaH6zw-ffTq8N3pVx3UVlCIBVYySdadgeAFw3q96t2a-rMwX1MKHyF-rb3Ccl0E2LvMiouYkbRsiXiRaxoWzMI-Hcp3OYeJYyQ)**
The side that identifies low-propensity conservatives, gets them to request or complete a ballot, follows up when it sits unfinished on the kitchen table, and makes sure it is returned and counted.
_That is exactly what ballot chasers do_...and the more of them we put in the field, the more voters we reach.
**Here’s how the scale works in practice:**

* One full-time chaser can build relationships with dozens of conservative voters in a precinct who rarely show up.

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1977, _Happy Days_ aired the infamous episode in which Fonzie, wearing swim trunks and his signature leather jacket, jumped over a caged shark on water skis. The stunt inspired the phrase "[jump the shark](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkE2ynSAQRlejMyxuiz8MGGTi7GWaodVCq_2CYAF6y6w-dbOFLOD76pzz62v-QvYctp94kClrnAO9s6dSKM0uXZvjbOMVyomJc7ocBcp5Bgm9kFqAnNEWvmlWWDuzEgG1NZnXMOpRjwN09W66pVdqXHprO9Av2TnbtwpBa9kpRf1Ss_n8SQ3yJWUHbbOQ7lekcbWDWocRKiXJcYmp-Y4cyk6rf-JNqbHxqL3ZSzlz1f6oYKpg4lAo3Uzv3BTydHPmGNCio-P5DCqYPo4VTK0UD2HKArcoSnT4iDWGP0wCgxM7nucjHD5ZfF_HSU6UnUTeMf2uk3Hnm73n3A-VktuB7P_BlP9seBv4GwAA___reonv)," describing the moment a TV show peaks and begins declining in quality. [See the notorious jump here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0EFygyAUANDT4C4OfjDCgkWnHXdmJqsuHSIf8zMoFjCpt--0V-gF3uJ9DuNgKdA6X-yCpvg4rvjKAUvBNLq0z47yFPe1bDZRTrvDFXMegcP5xPUJ-GinQk8cpa2c8YiAokLTdEorrTpoq7sRQk2tBa07JVt00mpspG7U5BvpRWsrMr8e18AbzlsQ9Q312VtUfuqk7xQwydFRial-RFrLHX044hNTPcWlCuZeypaZeGPQM-iPuJe9viGD_j3roVlObpsHJvpMTHxc9iy-rva4PrKUy_xdJeO2F4VA-dwxyefFUvhzyz87ngZ-AgAA__9uU3SJ). If you recall Saturday mornings as the best part of your childhood, those memories likely involve hours of animated cartoons. For decades, the three TV networks offered a programming combination that started off the weekend on a high note. Today's [_Whatever Happened To ..._](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAQxvGnwVsscjjGHhgqVemUduyIMBz2VcREcLaVt6_SV-j6fdJv-H_f7M1RonX-dHc0HLNd8agJmbHYULY5UPV5W_nhCtWyBVyxVgsS-pMcTyCt80w72s41wUREQNWgOethHMZBw6VZjApOSdRh6M9RY0AIY6fAow_BgZygIfPy5AjyLOUFVDvh2EeHQ_S6i3oA0UkMxLm0P5lWXjCmZ96xtD7fm2QW5kcV6k3AVcD1OI72mTfeJnz9r8WxX4S67kK9dx_P20xfWCfZFBMeB6VEtdeik_PdUfoj-Z8ldgO_AQAA__9uB3Rk) explains why those days are a thing of the past. In case you missed it on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Christopher revealed the six exercises physical therapists actually recommend to their patients. Most people don't notice their strength and balance slipping until something as simple as standing up from a chair gets hard. But when therapists were asked what really works, the same six simple moves came up again and again, and we walked through each one, including one you can do while waiting for your morning coffee. ## States Join Medicaid Discount Plan
President Trump announced on Friday that all 50 states will join the administration's [Medicaid drug-pricing model](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQhZ8Gd6zwrP8oKNK4u2lTWlwYvBNhsGC8Vt4-YqU8QbpPM9LMOd-vr-3LUqS0_7QHGg55S3jXiMxYNl-u3VN1-Up82kK1XB4T1rqBgkkqLUFt1jG9cRts501ABHx2aPp50YteZhi7l0H_HCcPPugAvg9hsXoAFfrefjvf67kj0-4pDapXaoTn4xv1FCwuwc1DmBcQg0JPnMvjd6bELwzxT35jebh8dNG8mM8qnj8ErALW-74fV2012lrA2lDAeuZITK6hLUwuYsN_TfpFwMrlOk7JWdqU8pUcShujHJWsbBmrbN8p7fJAT86Sl82QPAu5zzR7jF0x_rwpRqrTLAa1H5biJyf_p963gb8BAAD__5idkmA), tying the price of select Medicaid drugs to the lowest rates paid in other wealthy nations, which the White House says will save states billions. The plan commits 26 major pharmaceutical companies [_to enact drug pricing for federal agencies_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLEO3CAQRL8Gd5zwnm3sgiIN3aVNaRFYfBthsGDt0_195PxCph3paeb9eq0vR4ny9tPtaDiWNeOnJWTGuoZ6boGaL2fmw1Vq9QyYsbUVFExSLRLU6jzThevgumAiIuCzQ9PreZmXWcPYvY3y6HU_IPZ3AEbttRqnMOnQj4MfOzI3Ty2geqVGeD5-4zJFh3P0eoh6BjEoDMSlPv4UyvzGmL7lwvrwZe-SeTMfTTx_CLACbP4epfFdCbA3WIBViwDbzwLs2eT9UIB1KclRycaOsclysKTMRXI996PJ6K5SMcjsmEpu8nYhj0qe8iZjqXLHQN5REGC7asLxoZSoTVoMatsdpX_b-D-VXgb-BgAA__-REYvb) that match the rates paid in eight other high-income nations, including Canada, Germany, Japan, and the UK. States could save Medicaid $64 billion over the next 10 years, according to a White House Council of Economic Advisers estimate. The model operates through the existing Medicaid Drug Rebate Program and [_focuses on brand-name drugs_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2upDAQBODTQGZkml8HDjaZbDbdEPXYDdO7xkZ2M2hv_8S7wstLpfrqz3N5IgeO22_cycqalkhXCSRCefH53DwXl84oB2Yu-fQUqZQFNIxKGwV6QSf8oaXH2tuVCKirybbTbGYzTzDUbzt30GI3IbbrOPbGuellOj_oWSOZjqBme_dpA7rVeoCueZEZV6R5dVO_TjNUvSbPknLzN3GUN63hf_pQblza62DfIkepul8VPCp4XNfV3IiL6N8dqOAh-dwPtZNnh-zV7VJHZsdxU0fAqDAENWhVBIWK2tkL5V1RICecomqhH_VgoM7WHxeHwGWcql5vO3L4HiE__O5j4SsAAP__YMWFzw). States can choose which eligible drugs they want covered under the model, but must adopt standardized coverage criteria.
## Trump, Xi Prepare for State Visit This Week
U.S. officials [_will greet Chinese President Xi Jinping_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAURL9Gd3TwCggLFrPpXc92lgbh0t4JogG0Z_7-xfcLb1mppFLn_HnNL0eJ8vu329C2uM8ZPzVha1jmUM53oOr3M7fDFarlDJix1hk4KMYNAz473-jCWbg-2IgIOPZoh0kbbfQEsl-t8Ki05CMiaGUGr6UZEExUXuLite7J3nvcAB84lzA-FjQqOtTRTyJOGjrBMVDby-PvTrmtGNP__cLy8PvWJ7u2dtRu_NXBs4OnO26Eu7pDaeQTdvBs5dwO9o-YXyk7VptryC6q1FignLEwLhYwboRFOTEFJ6VTAoIQgxSDDFPsiw3Hh1KiqqZO8PfmKH1faD80d1n4CgAA__9DR4LH) at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday, rather than at the White House, for the first state visit by the leader of China in more than a decade. The visit will include [_an arrival ceremony_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSnSAQRp9GOxxEAS0o0tjdtCmdVRbvZlAcWDXJ02fu_wp_-xXfnHN-veYXUKRj-wk7Og5pPvApEZkxzz5fm6eypuvgEzKVfHk8sJRZSWWEHIWSM6xMN8491N4FRIVdja61wziMg1W6fruwGBy1XG2r-w69hmAAOgUWjdW4Qk3u8ydHJVspteqaBUcTAIew2j7YQVW9RE-ccvM70cFvDPFvujE3a9rr6N7MZ6m6H5WaKjU9z9PwUj4ezYH8WVKOfqF_lZquApWaOF_7Kc4IRxFbRmTxhwRQPlNmATnTDVGkEGgliEW0ujeDNnV2_nwoRirGVr3cdqD4hcDfLHc79T8AAP__RqiGPQ) inside the White House, a Rose Garden military review, and a state dinner. [_A number of key issues_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGupDAQBNDTmIyRaYxtAgebkM2mGyIvbqBXxkZ2M7P_9l_MFX5cpSdV_XnOT0-R0vbbH-h4zXPCd43IjGUO5doC1SVfiU9fqJYrYMJaZ5CgWzm2IGe_ML1wVr4JbkUE7Bt0nbGjHa2BodmdCtbKYI0OPWolA3RdrxejzWB65TtsyN2eHEF2Ug7QP_7iqFePdl2MWo0FoSQG4lwe_zIl3nGNX_mF5bHko4luZz6r6H8JmARMvONOMd6ZgGnPB96TBEw-HJSocvFMOQmYtBwHUF37n9rbrS2X6zjbt687pY0_naa4cL4pRqraCCW3w9PHbviHd70cfAcAAP__2FqAbw) are likely to come up during the visit, including trade, artificial intelligence, and rare earth minerals. U.S. officials said Washington and Beijing may be ready to ease tariffs on some nonstrategic goods. Separately, [_Treasury Secretary Bessent_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI7MQLApXGxDl22i1ZbI4DHMymA0NmTz9095v_DqK12dc_4-xoejSPvy221oS0jjjq8csRTk0fO5eMpzOvdyOKbMp8cdcx5BQSdVL0GNbi504di6ytuACNhUaGttetMbDfdqtQZ770w99cY3Rpm6VdNk6jBrM3UARldkP3-qB1UrdYfmNmHfBYcmzLoN2oBoFXoqiW__Eu1lxRDf6UK-zWmrol1LObJofgkYBAxumj8On03A8OcpYHgR47MkfgsYCp_bIR3xkbjIhRGL_E9yXml3WUZ0Hlk6ZrowyzPLuunuWoNqKrb-eFGMlDstWrVsjuI3QflhuMvCVwAAAP__SLSD_g) will meet over the weekend in New York with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to discuss a range of economic issues.
## LIST: Most Popular Breakfast Cereals by State
Froot Loops is the most popular breakfast cereal in 13 states and [the most-searched cereal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOrCAUgOGnwU6DBxUsKG5jN7fd0pyBwwwbFAPHMfP2m9lX2PpPvuL_uq03jCnuj_-4keWQ152umoiZyurL-fCxunzufGCJtZyedqp1BQlTK-cW5IqO44vWARtvAxGQasj22sxmNhrG5ml7iSAlyuluxqC9ggnUoJzpA2qFemyi_XhyBtlLOYLq7jRPAckEp4egDYhBko-cS_ed485PCumdX1Q6l7cm2SfzUYX6J2ARsFzX1RX_SQIWLBxdIgHLliu3Rz7OhKV1VAhTe3-3lZE_uSnWH1dMKdZJi0E-Nozp1-c_bnlZ-AkAAP__aFV4QQ) in the U.S., according to Google Trends. The tropical-fruit-flavored sugar rings dominate throughout the South, while two relatively healthy options, Cheerios and Rice Krispies, each won five states. Not surprisingly, many state favorites were among [the most sugar-laden options](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-OszAQBPCngc7ImH-mcPE1dPnaK9EGr8EXY6P1EpS3P-XyCFeO9NNoNF-3-QY--Lj-hx0NuzRHvHJAZqTZ0rlan5d0Rj6AfKbTYsScZyVVL-QolJxhYf_EuYXSGoeosCnR1IMe9agH1ZWbaZuuhUW5HqV1Y6_R6jvWvQOtunoAW3rz7pOjkrWUnWqqO469A9RuGVo3aFW0Eq3nRNV38pE3dOGVnkjVkvYymI35yEXzr1BToabruqodmdIBhJHfplDTJ_i4FmriDcWVKLPI5wr0EgsSQsjCJRIPb7MgiA-04v76CHEgLRAZVhRdL4eSjD0uH4LP_VC0ct3Bh98x_McPn0b9BAAA___t7Iqb). Post Golden Crisp, with 42% sugar by weight, carried Ohio and Indiana. Wheat-based cereals were not so popular. Wheaties, Raisin Bran, and Frosted Mini-Wheats each came out on top in a single state.

**Whatever happened to Saturday morning cartoons?** For a solid three decades, Saturday morning in America meant one thing for kids: wake up before your parents, pour a bowl of something frosted, and park yourself in front of the TV for hours of cartoons. It was appointment viewing before the term existed, and it shaped a generation. Kids memorized [the Saturday morning cartoon schedules](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAYhJ8Gd7bIb8dAQXE6yV3SRKcrEYYfmw2GCHCsvP0qu_sG246-GY2-_xd10T74uFz1hrK6pCIeJWCtmJXN-2J9MWmP9aGzL3m3GLEUBRTGlooWqNKm-ieqQTdWOkTAvkF5YlxwwRmcm1XOQgzczeCo6Bk7z8JyrbGHAZyZObONl-89KoCeKD1D380oRqeRO8MGxziQgaL1NeXuI_lYV3ThlZ6YO5O2Jsi11kch_R8CE4GprtgWXfds9avdUo4-Lq3RuaYUO6ejTdu7R2A6_N0TmG4_sLp8w-pmVrR7wKII8H83dcV6pHwvBP6qkxipagkIAv2kQ3gHQ5OlfRw-BF9GRga6bNqHr3P1l06fEj4DAAD__5U9jdM). Then, gradually, it all went away. The tradition took root in the early 1960s when Hanna-Barbera, the studio behind _The Flintstones_ , _The Jetsons_ , and dozens more, began filling network schedules with made-for-TV animation. By 1966, all three, ABC, NBC, and CBS, were programming full animation blocks between 8 a.m. and noon. Here's a [TV ad promoting CBS' 1965 lineup](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAQxvGnwVsscjjGHhgqVemUduyIMBz2VcREcLaVt6_SV-j6fdJv-H_f7M1RonX-dHc0HLNd8agJmbHYULY5UPV5W_nhCtWyBVyxVgsS-pMcTyCt80w72s41wUREQNWgOethHMZBw6VZjApOSdRh6M9RY0AIY6fAow_BgZygIfPy5AjyLOUFVDvh2EeHQ_S6i3oA0UkMxLm0P5lWXjCmZ96xtD7fm2QW5kcV6k3AVcD1OI72mTfeJnz9r8WxX4S67kK9dx_P20xfWCfZFBMeB6VEtdeik_PdUfoj-Z8ldgO_AQAA__9uB3Rk). What followed was a golden age for kids: _Scooby-Doo_ , _Super Friends_ , _Underdog_ , _Schoolhouse Rock!_ , _The Smurfs_ , and later _G.I. Joe_ , _Transformers_ , and _He-Man,_ a full morning's worth of child-focused entertainment. The whole ecosystem ran on sugar cereal. Kellogg's, General Mills, and Post poured enormous ad dollars into Saturday mornings, [deploying cartoon mascots of their own,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFurDAQRb_GdCAzsNguXLyGbl-bEnnt8TKRwcgeFuXvo02RH0h3i6tzpPNxX-6OEu3P_25DyzEvO141ITOWJZTzGaj6fO58uEK1nAF3rHUBCVMrTQtycZ7phcvommAjIuDQoO2VNtpoBbdmtSGCvukpRGfGXkk_euNNBDV5Y9yjHxqyb540IHspbzB0DzRTdKijV2NUGsQoMRDn0n1m2nnFmL7yC0vn89YkuzIfVQz_BMwC5uu6umslRp_yGer7I2DmfLS9_B2tx4IutZurPnMVMDfFhuOilKhOSozyuTlKPwL-Y5eXhe8AAAD__0XLeI0) who became as iconic to kids as any other TV character. The networks got rich, the cereal companies moved product, and kids got four glorious hours of animation. Everybody won. The decline came slowly, but from multiple directions. Cable channels like Nickelodeon and Cartoon Network began offering cartoons all day, every day, making the once-a-week block less special. VCRs, video games, and weekday syndication pulled viewers away. Then Congress passed the Children's Television Act in 1990, requiring educational programming that squeezed out pure entertainment. NBC dropped its cartoon lineup in 1992. ABC held on through 2011. The very last broadcast block, The CW, signed off on September 27, 2014, and was replaced by a live-action educational lineup. The cartoons themselves live on. In 2024, Weigel Broadcasting [launched MeTV Toons](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO3CAQhJ_G7jhhzNlQUKS57k-b0tqDxd4EwwnWtvL2kfMKfzszGs18v76WL6BEef0JOzqOZcl4tYTMWJdQjzVQ8-XI_IFKrR4BM7a2KKkmIa1QcgHPdOKioQ8uIioce3TDbKyxZlbPfnMKbBwnPRit42DnWXmvwwTBjsaPGkxP7u6TVslByqcaH2-0UwQ00c86zkZ1WmIgLvXxu1DmDWP6W06sD1_2PrmN-dO68UenXp16Xdf18O_2NLfbqdd96JaRVkziXQsED40pr4KLSHBkv4kd-RRcSm4i4yUy8lXqHxEwkAfGcEd9gtbIC8i0A1PJfXXhc1FK1Ka503LdgdL_TfxNlKdT_wIAAP__ynOM2A), a 24/7 network devoted to the classics, from _Bugs Bunny_ to _Scooby-Doo_ to _The Jetsons_. For a solid three decades, Saturday morning in America meant one thing for kids: wake up before your parents, pour a bowl of something frosted, and park yourself in front of the TV for hours of cartoons. It was appointment viewing before the term existed, and it shaped a generation. Kids memorized . Then, gradually, it all went away. The tradition took root in the early 1960s when Hanna-Barbera, the studio behind The Flintstones , The Jetsons , and dozens more, began filling network schedules with made-for-TV animation. By 1966, all three, ABC, NBC, and CBS, were programming full animation blocks between 8 a.m. and noon. Here's a . What followed was a golden age for kids: Scooby-Doo , Super Friends , Underdog , Schoolhouse Rock! , The Smurfs , and later G.I. Joe , Transformers , and He-Man, a full morning's worth of child-focused entertainment. The whole ecosystem ran on sugar cereal. Kellogg's, General Mills, and Post poured enormous ad dollars into Saturday mornings, who became as iconic to kids as any other TV character. The networks got rich, the cereal companies moved product, and kids got four glorious hours of animation. Everybody won. The decline came slowly, but from multiple directions. Cable channels like Nickelodeon and Cartoon Network began offering cartoons all day, every day, making the once-a-week block less special. VCRs, video games, and weekday syndication pulled viewers away. Then Congress passed the Children's Television Act in 1990, requiring educational programming that squeezed out pure entertainment. NBC dropped its cartoon lineup in 1992. ABC held on through 2011. The very last broadcast block, The CW, signed off on September 27, 2014, and was replaced by a live-action educational lineup. The cartoons themselves live on. In 2024, Weigel Broadcasting , a 24/7 network devoted to the classics, from Bugs Bunny to Scooby-Doo to The Jetsons. The shows survived. The ritual didn't. body:
A heartfelt message from a veteran fighting for you.

A heartfelt message from a veteran fighting for you.
| [](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch._pQ)
---

Guided by my faith and surrounded by my wife, a high school sweetheart, and our beautiful children, I've experienced firsthand the blessings of America's greatest values.
[My life's mission has been to preserve this American greatness, first by serving in the Air Force and now as a constitutional lawyer fighting anyone who infringes upon our freedom.](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.)
Yet, I've seen time and time again how fragile our liberty is and the countless evil minds that seek to either take advantage of America or outright destroy it.
And let me tell you, the Radical Leftists have been especially relentless.
They would do anything for their woke agenda, but they would do absolutely nothing for our nation.
[As a proud seventh-generation Texan, I am beyond fed up.](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.)
I'm fighting because Texas needs a leader who is unapologetically patriotic and is not afraid to say so. There are far too many politicians who are bought or compromised, having long forgotten why they decided to serve in the first place.
[President Trump has seen my commitment to America First, and I am honored to have his 100% endorsement. But the Radical Left is doubling down on its attacks against me because they know America First is their greatest enemy.](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch._Q)
That's why I need your help, Peter.

---

[Having an endorsement from a patriot like you would send a powerful message to the Radical Left that true patriots understand who is actually fighting for Texas and our nation.](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.)

\- Jace Yarbrough

## Feds to Send Texas $7.5 Billion
The federal government will send Texas $7.5 billion to repay the state for Operation Lone Star, Gov. Greg Abbott [announced Friday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SnDAQhU8jMk21ehhAgQInytapQ0o_rUFlQFRLw-7c3sX6CBt3ff2-9_58zB8ur3l__nYbmfaVyrzTZ12pNeI5UWQ63LuOD19fzOXpGvnC-4yAgwQtEWYXWj5p7l0XjYeoVUdGjZPWgKqHbjGp9zF5dQedHndF_eACYPRDcMqplKjL5noHGkEpQDXdQAeVBj0NYQwhTSh6oJhb4VtbqNGXq2l9l5P4FsrWrWZp7aji_kugFWj_ntldB4H26iLQ-sKRWKC9cgRa0AKtmgTauFTpjoPLSVWO8iF9XtdcdvkfkZXCi3N7S6a8-RdX2mhvMhWW3x4CbccmHp8XVodR9PDcXF6_xdpPBz0N_gsAAP__PGGLTQ). Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin confirmed the award, which covers three-quarters of a [$10 billion pot](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkTGOpDAQRU8DmVt2wRg7INiEbDbdEJXtAqw1GNnVzcztV7TmBpt91Zde6en_-Zw_MaZ4rL9xp5G_ljwfdNVEzFTmhUKhE7_r8OHqs5S8IpPL5ZhBghbSCpAzeo4vmntsw-hksKqlUQ3GWgmql-026gC0BNIDLro3YJTuyJohoALXaYttHG-ctCCVkqDMQ1qvFm2N9oP3i4GmlxQi5_LgjZi-sC7pO7-oPHze2zRuzGdtul8NTA1M13U9_r6edJcNTFg4-kQNTLdZA9OZU-To7xj3Pa4FOeZD_LRvvMgn_ZxTPkhUxiLW--ORi1gLrQKdy8yiUNzds1Ta6WAR6MTC77jlnRIeQVTyzxL5W4Tt5oO2wnkMgSgI6s0ietSDMNoHYT4UknadJujaMobziinFqoeml-uOMb19-X93eo3wLwAA__8AYKuY) created in last year's tax-and-spending bill. Texas applied in June. "_Texas held the line when Washington would not_ ," Abbott said. The money still falls short of the $11.1 billion the state says it spent on barriers, buoys, National Guard deployments, and trespassing prosecutions. Democrats uniformly opposed the bill that created the fund. Gina Hinojosa, their nominee for governor, has [pressed Abbott](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO3CAQxvGnwR0WEJ8xBUUad5c2pTWYsRcJgzXMrW_fPvJKeYKrpvnrp9H393P5hJRT2f_AgZ6_t7oUvFpGZqRlw0h4wqvZj9C-iOoOjKFSWYwyo1ROGrXAyumJywBd9EFFpzv02k7OKaMH1T08hPiBEKMGO2kEjSboVQ1uDGqzFm2X_M0pZ5TWyuipV27V2-imcbXruk1GDApj4ko9P5DxG9qWX_WJ1K_16LJ_MJ9N_PotzCzMfF1XHypFJMKzEt-RMDPhnmppwsxv4f-VjVPO8oLEqeyyFqm1DCnnVItMRW4YkSBLwnSEL2p4YOEmCTMwRslV1hMJ-M5zLSgbAwkzd-Tjed1OG60Y1H5Ayu9_-ac7P735FwAA__8HUpdl) to collect the money and spend it on household relief. Abbott said Texas is also seeking a share of a separate Justice Department fund to recover the rest.
## UT-Austin Cuts Three Race, Gender Majors
The University of Texas at Austin has [stopped enrolling new students](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHS2yAQhJ8GdXjgol-GgiIN3Z82peYMh0QGSx44JPvtM8orpN6dnW-_39_zN-aSt-UXPsnxO-3zRmcrxEx1ThQrvfDT7l-P1mvdF2R67HWbQcEklZWgZgycD5pHHKJ7qGj1QE7fjbUK9KiG1T2-tElGWa2jwRhH0COmMI0aE9mQ0pDdNacsKK0VaHNTNug0WTOFewjJgBgVxcx7vfFKTG9sqXz2g-ot7M-huJX51cSPnwK8AH-e5y1vLUda87JSpXjVBPjrmQCfMPTCHwE-9Fpz6KVf6cUgwCsrwGsjwHeW2BvnTeKbmmx0UMUiidctB7nQFqnKxj1mavKJf_bahuri68yl5DbdxaiWJ-byD5L_V-7h4G8AAAD__7iskMY) in three majors: African and African Diaspora Studies, Mexican American and Latino Studies, and Women's and Gender Studies. Interim department chair Danielle Clealand told faculty the provost's office rejected their proposal to keep the majors. Students already enrolled can finish their degrees. The university [confirmed the change](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAQRL8GOiNjHMCFi2vocu2VyJg17MVg5N2E5O9PyS9cM81Io3nv5zpeHUbcl2-3geVnSOMOJ0VghjwGmDMc7kXdZaJ7zmlxDFPK-6ikaoU0QsnRecYHjNqVs53kbOoSbN31xkhVa1mudlagQeuuvUzy0qs-mM43jXZdb4JvGyjRvuekUbKupar7Shpfh9b0re-8D70qtIQZOeWKV2B4OgrxlR6QK5-2MtqV-aCi-SrUUKjhPM8qpOeb490XajhSREZPhRoiBEZiMUO8E6adRHAeRAZ_Szvui0g7CLdBRu9ITLgsQCx8ihEWILG52yd_Uxa0uhuI-1FmOx8nxojUdoWWy-Ywfp7xf40-rPoLAAD__3YJjwI) and gave professors until the end of the semester to propose a replacement major. UT [folded seven liberal arts departments into two](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiPbIRgXLq6hy7VXosVeE0sGo_USkrc_5e4R_nY0Gs33_XnMD0g57etv2NDxO5Z5x6tmZEaaIwbCAz7V3Jd6EpUVGJdC-6ylHoS0QssZPKcXzj20wS0yWNWiU2a0VmrVy_bpNN5vGrUK0kRjMNqohjvgAOOiPBhsk_vOSaulUlKrsZPWqzjYcfDG-zjqppcYEhfq-ImMb6gxf8oLqfNla7N7Mh-1uf1q9NTo6bquLpa3gbNy2r-VRk9fqkZPJ4v_sTioRKy1UBWRzsoEjEEEPIB4w50F5rSlHTiVvQpfcsYVRU4LEmQBxLUlF44r5ZzqYJperhuk_O8R_9Tky-m_AQAA__8KzI1d) in February, citing fragmentation and lopsided student-to-faculty ratios. Roughly 307 students were enrolled across those majors and American studies, under 1% of undergraduates. Julie Minich, a professor of Mexican American and Latino studies, said the cut ends UT's long role in building that field. Texas A&M dropped its women's and gender studies degree earlier this year.
## Court Lets Surrogate-Born Baby Leave Texas
The Texas Supreme Court [refused Thursday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd0TD2AFTUGzj7m27pTXAkCCROAJiv_z9KtnV_sCWd0b3Suf8-lq_KJd8v_ykG7v-nbb1zkcr3DvXNXGs_KBXM2ffnrVuF-rst3pfEVBLsBJhpdDzzutEQ3QeolUDO2VmawHVBMPVaTsCwqhHGwgmVimCRjXS2ZOKyaghu_ccWASlANV8AhtU0nbWwYSQZhQTcMx9q6d-5c7f1FJ5bTvXU9huQ3HX3h9NjD8ELgKX4zhORyJ6PwUuVHsOhQUubzKBS-vU3_EzJP8e_4T2fFS-sQzbs3ZZn4Wb9ORfMnLJO1eO8p8HWZh2lp-iwAVnI43XiCOd5VlpLacxjXKO3kibLIKNdgY2Q3XxceRSctNGTHC5US4fjv6__neHvwMAAP__IGWZPw) to stop a California couple from taking their infant son out of Texas for heart treatment in Los Angeles. The court sided with [Nausheen Gilkar and Omar Ahmed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAQhZ_G7oiG8R8UFLdxl9tuaQEeJyjYWDBxkrdfeaV9gq1OcXSOPn1f1-lqQwzb7b9dyfB7SdNGrxKJmfK00Jxpt58ydK48c043y-RS3iYE7AVogTBZz-GgqbX1bBzMWtZk5KC0BpQt1HeDsnFAqlFDMwxz23XOa0ndArio3rZNHcx5BxpBSkCpLqC9XHqtej94vyisWqA5cMoXvhPT25YlftJB-eLTWkdzZ95L1fyrcKxwtM7L5mwqHAun_Dnzl17Y8iiiPPdMKwmfnplF2JjyQRsJbzOJEvxDOOvOndRK9m2vKhzrbOb9FWIMpR-qFm6rDfEHgP8q7jD4HQAA__8El4Ix), the boy's biological parents, over McKenna West, the Alaska nurse who carried and delivered him in Dallas on Aug. 12. Justices wrote that sustaining the child's life was the paramount concern. The boy was born with hypoplastic left heart syndrome and has already had one surgery. West [refused the couple's request](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAQhJ_GdEb2hj8XLtLQ3bQp0WKvD9YBjOwFzn37iBR5gdQjfTPz_f6avjCucX_9wo0sf0KadrrLSsyUp0A-04HfpW_ncuacXsg0p7xPoKCTykhQEzqOF00NVt7OyhtdkdX9YIwC3ahqsTgE02OvSDvfGQ1tAPSAvWvnhroWq2gfnDKgtFagh1oZp0Nnhs71zoUBRKPIR0655oWYPljC-p0uyrVLW7Xahfko4sdPAaOA8b7v-j3z5wkFjA9bwKiMgFErAeO_J_JekswUzkJeLniRxDlljmmXWN5FlvPItJF06cws486UL9pJPs2yRPeWO92PDgFjla0_7riusXS9aNRrw7j-ncf_q_Wy8CcAAP__6UCOkg) for an abortion after the diagnosis and traveled to Texas, which bans most abortions, to give birth and seek custody. She says she doesn't trust them to pursue surgery. The couple's lawyers say hospice isn't part of the plan and that doctors have no concerns about their decisions. West has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to intervene.

name: Cooper HQ
subject: Why we keep asking (honestly)
body:
The truth is, we’re behind on our fundraising targets. Way behind.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1393&source=&t=1&akid=3629%2E124072%2EMjIxIR) | | | |
---
Peter – here’s the truth:
**We’re behind on our fundraising targets.** In fact, we’re nowhere near the number of grassroots donations we’ll need to win this race.
We know we ask a lot of this team, but we’re hoping you’ll [**_chip in your first contribution of $5 to help us get back on track today._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8283?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1393&amount=5&t=8&akid=3629%2E124072%2EMjIxIR) Let us explain why.
First, it’s not cheap to run a statewide ad campaign and reach voters with our message. With more than 7.8 million registered voters across ten media markets – including two of the most expensive in the United States (Charlotte and Raleigh-Durham) – it can cost as much as $5 million to run an ad.
Second, this will be one of the most expensive Senate races in U.S. history. The GOP’s already spending more than $100 million to defeat us, and since the majority hinges on this seat, experts at Politico say **we can expect to be outspent" substantially more"** between now and Election Day.
Last but not least – President Trump is now personally wading in to tip the scales in our MAGA opponent’s favor. A few days ago, he came to North Carolina for a rally where he told lie after lie about Roy, and a super PAC linked to Trump is currently dumping millions into this race to crush our momentum.
If we don’t see a surge of grassroots support, we’ll have some difficult decisions to make this week.
Because frankly, we're spending money faster than we’re raising it at this point (we only have 44 days left), and we’ll have to spend even more in light of what's coming from the GOP.
**Our only hope is that people like you – who understand the stakes of this race – give what you can to help fill in the gaps. So if flipping North Carolina, retaking the Senate and preventing two more years of unchecked GOP rule matter to you, we have to ask:**
[**_Will you make your first contribution of $5 or more to our grassroots campaign today? We’re short of where we need to be to keep up the fight, and the timing is not great._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8283?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1393&amount=5&t=9&akid=3629%2E124072%2EMjIxIR)

Listen up, patriot...

I need to tell you about the worst 4 minutes of my life.

Last November, my neighbor's son fell off his bike. Hard.

Head wound. Blood everywhere. The kid was screaming.

His mom was frozen in panic.

I ran over to help...

And realized I had nothing.

No pressure bandages. No trauma supplies. Just some old Band-Aids in a drawer somewhere.

I stood there, helpless, watching a 9-year-old bleed while we waited for the ambulance.

12 minutes felt like 12 hours.

The paramedic later told me: "If that cut had been 2 inches to the left, those 12 minutes could have killed him."

That's when I learned the brutal truth:

The American Red Cross reports that 59% of injury deaths could have been prevented with proper first aid BEFORE the ambulance arrived.

Read that again.

More than half of people who died from injuries would still be alive if someone nearby had been prepared.

And according to the CDC, 44% of Americans don't even have a proper first aid kit in their home.

That ends today.

I spent the last year working with combat medics and EMTs to create something different.

Not another drugstore bandage collection...

But a real trauma kit that handles serious injuries when seconds count.

The 1stHour Trauma First Aid Kit

This is what's inside:

→ Combat tourniquet (stops life-threatening bleeding in seconds)

→ Israeli trauma bandage (battlefield-proven wound compression)

→ Compressed gauze (handles deep wounds)

→ CPR rescue mask (when every breath counts)

→ EMT scissors (cuts through anything)

→ Splint roll, burn gel, emergency blanket

→ Plus 75 more military-grade items

All organized in a compact, waterproof bag.

Normally $139.

Today? Just $49.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDV9AAwAAAAAAw7mu9nIItHGCKxtifZgTLZHYZ56Bs9A6MR_g_8qdCs29ji2ISFNC0el_5CwCibXmCCxcD2rlGPNmlWnDKEQpSVtvXajNLZS4uVHkyzJrQ
Claim Your Trauma Kit at 65% OFF

But here's the catch:

I only have 81 units left at this price.

Once they're gone, this deal disappears forever.

And honestly?

In an emergency, this kit could mean the difference between holding pressure on a wound and watching helplessly.

Between stabilizing an injury and making it worse.

Between a close call and a funeral.

You don't get a second chance to be prepared.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDV9AAwAAAAAAw7mu9nJWaUW4FU78Tcuc2hWuV29-EXTtE4AY8IHx30B16rywtkiIjU25EONc1uWhKtvIAWteC6zTA9e2RmsOZrIGyj3XspkhChlB-nrYQ
Grab Your Kit Now - Only 81 Left

I still think about that November day.

The kid was fine, thank God.

But I promised myself I'd never be unprepared again.

And I'm here to make sure you don't have to learn this lesson the hard way.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Want to see my gorgeous dahlias? 📸
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Growing a garden is a lot like growing our movement.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260920-6740-footer&t=1&akid=6740%2E420207%2Ew0V6fG)
Peter,
One of my absolute favorite things to do is spend time in my garden.
This weekend, I cut dahlias I’ve been growing in my backyard. Being in my garden surrounded by all of the beautiful flowers and greenery, I felt pure peace and joy!
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260920-1.rSgfNS&refcode=em20260920-6740&t=2&akid=6740%2E420207%2Ew0V6fG)
I’ve put in so much work nurturing these wonderful flowers — and thinking about that really made me pause for a second.
I think about it a lot, actually — what it takes to grow something. You can’t rush it. You have to show up, consistently, even when nothing seems to be happening. You water, you tend, and you wait. And then one day, something beautiful blooms that wasn’t there before.
**That’s what we’re doing here, Peter, because growing a garden is a lot like growing a movement.**
Our movement didn’t sprout overnight. It was born out of our collective resistance. It grew from the soil that is our community. Organizing together, showing up, refusing to give in for _years_ , even when the ground felt dry and progress felt slow. We’ve never given up.
30,000+ people trained in nonviolent resistance. Progressive candidates winning races across the country against millions in dark money. A people-powered movement that is strong, determined, and continuing to grow each day.
**That is what sustained, grounded, and committed organizing looks like.** Just like a garden, you don’t just plant the seeds and walk away. You nurture it. You protect it. You come back to it every single day, and trust that the work you’re putting in right now will bloom into something extraordinary.
I want you to think about that every time you feel discouraged. Every time the headlines get too loud and you start to lose hope. Think of these dahlias, think of every seed we’ve sprouted across this movement, and take a moment to fill yourself up with beauty. Know that there’s a whole movement of fighters standing right alongside you, and **we are going to win.**
[**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260920-1.rSgfNS&refcode=em20260920-6740&t=3&akid=6740%2E420207%2Ew0V6fG)
We’re in the final stretch to November — and the moment we’ve been working towards is almost here. But I need you with me to finish strong.
[**If you can, will you please pitch in $3, or whatever is meaningful to you today to help us keep growing this movement all the way to November?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260920-1.rSgfNS&refcode=em20260920-6740&amount=3&t=4&akid=6740%2E420207%2Ew0V6fG)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260920-1.rSgfNS&amount=3&refcode=em20260920-6740&t=23&akid=6740%2E420207%2Ew0V6fG)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20260920-6740-footer&t=24&refcode2=6740_420207_w0V6fG&akid=6740%2E420207%2Ew0V6fG)**

# **[Oregon Frees Christian Mom To Adopt: State Cannot Compel Gender Views](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/133/71965/1637c7c8e5a1b82ea9712809305597e6b4378946/2c0c001e797a02a728408ba273e9861b4e8d7706)**
---
---
The state tried to make faith disqualifying. Oregon has agreed to stop blocking a Christian widow from adopting because she would not affirm the state’s views on gender identity. A federal court signed the settlement Sept 9th, and her lawyers announced the win this week.Oregon had turned a routine adoption screening into a belief test, excluding an entire class of religious parents from a foster system short of homes. The settlement draws a line other states will now have to notice.
---
|
---
# **[Gun Groups Target NY Park Carry Ban](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/133/71965/acecaaafdeb9bae529e1f23c40347bab4e4ce691/2c0c001e797a02a728408ba273e9861b4e8d7706)**
---
---
Two national gun-rights groups asked the Supreme Court on Sept 16th to strike down New York’s ban on carrying a licensed firearm in public parks. The petition tees up the next major test of the Court’s 2022 Bruen decision. New York rewrote its carry law the moment the Justices expanded gun rights, and the parks ban is one of the last pieces still standing. How the Court answers will set the rules for “sensitive places” nationwide.
---
|
---
# **[16 Months, Zero Border Releases: Campaign Promises Being Executed](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/133/71965/611d66eeeaac460d58c58f5a6f39e5598f9b111b/2c0c001e797a02a728408ba273e9861b4e8d7706)**
---
---
Catch and release is over. The border has now gone 16 straight months without releasing a single migrant on parole, the Trump administration said, as August crossings fell to historic lows. DHS released the August figures Sept 16th. “Catch and release,” the practice of freeing migrants into the country to await hearings, was the single policy conservatives most blamed for the border crisis. Its complete shutdown, sustained now for over a year, is the administration’s clearest immigration win.

Attorney General Eric Holder and I started the NDRC because we truly believe that fairness is essential to a functioning, truly representative democracy.

body:
Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

| | | |
---
Friend,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.
---

Congress has opened an investigation into waste, fraud, and abuse of federal funds at the Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority (LAHSA), the lead agency coordinating L.A. County's homelessness response. Per Just the News, LAHSA has received more than **$1 billion in federal funds since 2021**, including **$220 million in 2024 alone**, yet the agency has struggled to account for how that money was spent. LAHSA reportedly "posed challenges to verifying spending," a central concern of the congressional probe.
**The Nepotism Allegation**
The most prominent accusation centers on former LAHSA CEO Va Lecia Adams Kellum. According to reporting by LAist (cited in the congressional inquiry), Kellum signed a **$2.1 million contract between LAHSA and Upward Bound House**, the nonprofit where her husband worked -- despite having been expected to recuse herself from the transaction due to the conflict of interest. Rep. Tim Burchett, leading the investigation for a House Oversight subcommittee, cited this as evidence of "blatant corruption" and has invited/requested that **Mayor Karen Bass testify** before Congress, given her oversight ties to the agency.

name: Chris Deluzio
subject: Vivek (and why I keep talking about youth sports)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
Did you see this?
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=93%2E42639%2Ez5hwpi)
Last week, Vivek Ramaswamy released a video of him trying to hit a baseball in a batting cage while parroting a bunch of far-right talking points.
It was embarrassing, and he pulled it from the internet after getting mocked by Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike.
Maybe you saw it?
My first thought after seeing it was about youth sports in America.
If you have kids (like me) or grandkids who play youth sports, you know that costs have gone up like crazy over the past few years. Access to the best soccer coaches, facilities, and equipment prices out countless families across the country.
Today in America, the average family is spending about $1,500 per kid on youth sports: basketball, baseball, soccer, dance, and any number of additional sports.
How did this happen?
Private equity rolled up youth sports in an effort to squeeze kids and families for every dollar they could. They buy up facilities, push out the rec leagues, they'll hold tournaments and force families to stay in hotels with expensive rates, they'll charge exorbitant fees to parents who want to just watch their kids play. Once their hooks are in, they have countless ways to extract revenue along the way, turning youth sports into a rich kid's game.
I know this isn't the first email I've sent on youth sports. I talk about it all the time. And people ask: why Chris, why do you talk about this so often?
This isn't just some sector of the economy, we are talking about access for kids to play sports. Did you play? Do you remember running around outside and having fun with friends?
How about if you are a parent or grandparent today? How important is that to you when you consider the alternative to that time playing outside is often the iPad and social media garbage?
It's locking far too many kids out ... and if private equity gets their way, far too many kids will grow up hitting a baseball like Vivek Ramaswamy.
That's why I introduced the Let Kids Play Act: to go right after the vulture investors and their practices pricing families out. When it comes to youth sports, we do not have to accept only corporate profits mattering.
**[Please watch my video on the cost of youth sports in America and, while you're there, like and follow my YouTube channel.](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/443?t=2&akid=93%2E42639%2Ez5hwpi)**

Don't give up the ship,
Chris Deluzio

To all VoteVets supporters: Please, don’t scroll past this.
We’re interrupting your Sunday morning to humbly ask you to make a contribution.
Of all VoteVets supporters, just 1% make a donation. Many think they’ll contribute later and forget. Many make a mental note and move on.
But right now, VoteVets is closing out the largest midterm campaign we have ever run. The GOP is on the ropes, they’re doing everything they can to compromise our elections and tear our candidates down. But if we do not meet the moment, all bets are off.
If everyone reading this email right now chipped in as little as $2, we’d crush our fundraising goals. We’d have enough to run our operations indefinitely. We could redouble our efforts to reach, persuade, and turn out Veterans in these final weeks. They are the key to this election.
But not everyone donates. That’s why it’s so important that you do, if you can.

body:
In good hands

| Peter,
Throughout my life, my hands have done a lot of different things!
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-6tqHjQ)
---
They comforted hearts and healed wounds when I was a Nurse Practitioner.
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
They flew helicopters to protect our freedom when I served in the Navy.
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._Gjkn24XLV_B8lGX2i0vw)
---
They packed lunches, held hands, and instilled our values as a Mom to my four kids.
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._00EVFhkqBbuY9w)
---
Now on the campaign trail, I use these hands to put up yard signs and shake voters' hands!
Look, I’ll be honest... campaigning is a grind. It is unglamorous, exhausting work.
But I have never been afraid of getting my hands dirty. Whether it was flying Helos in the Persian Gulf, caring for patients as a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner, or hammering in my own yard signs on the side of the highway—I do what needs to be done.
Why? [Because the Left is coming for this seat with everything they have.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._HaM20XhhQb5PQ)
They are furious that we have the White House, the Senate, and the House. They are desperate to break our Republican majority and stop the America First agenda cold. I am their #1 target to flip the House.
I’m humbly asking you to lend me a hand. I can’t fight the liberal dark money machine alone.
---

| [CHIP IN TODAY](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-YjkFpQ)
---
Every dollar goes to the frontlines of this battleground. I’m willing to do the heavy lifting, but I need you to help buy the fuel.
Please step up today so I can keep fighting for you..!
Jen Kiggans

Peter,

On September 30, every federal campaign in America has to close its books
and tally up how much we fundraised and how much cash we have left to
spend.

Then that report is filed with the Federal Election Commission, and it’s
made public for all to see. Reporters read it. MAGA billionaire donors
read it. Mike Rogers' people read it.

They’ll all be looking for the same thing: whether this campaign has the
money to stay on the air and remain competitive through November.

To put us in the best possible position heading into the final stretch,
I’m setting a goal of raising an additional $5 million before September
30. [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260920-1-ak.ekfD98&amount=10&refcode=em20260920-3233&t=1004&akid=3243%2E251025%2Ee3vRmc ]If you can pitch in a few bucks to help us chip away at that goal,
I’d be so grateful. Even $10 makes a difference when tens of
thousands of you step up.

It's an ambitious goal. I'm not going to pretend otherwise.

But look at what we're up against: Mike Rogers is Donald Trump's
handpicked candidate, a career politician with over $70 million in
commitments from Trump, Elon Musk, and GOP Super PACs.

They’re not playing it safe. We can’t either.

Peter, what
happens in Michigan will determine who wins the Senate majority.

The latest polls show this race is neck-and-neck.

Winning this race isn’t possible if we miss the mark in moments like this.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260920-1-ak.ekfD98&amount=10&refcode=em20260920-3233&t=1005&akid=3243%2E251025%2Ee3vRmc ]That’s why I’m humbly asking for your support today. Can you donate

contribution gives us the resources we need to fight back and win.

Your friend in the fight,

Abdul

Hi friend,

At the Republican Midterm Convention last week, President Trump tried to hawk his strategy for this election: handing out $5,000 checks if Republicans keep control of the House and Senate. Let us call this what it is: a transparent attempt to buy an election and distract from systemic political corruption and a failing economy.

While everyday families struggle with the squeezing cost of housing, groceries, and health care, the Trump Administration is treating governance like a pay-to-play scheme. But we are not just watching this happen from the sidelines. We are taking proactive steps to safeguard our democracy and hold Washington accountable.

In Congress, I am combating President Trump’s agenda by pushing for the passage of the Freedom to Vote Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to protect ballot access. I am also fighting to pass the Restore Trust in Government Act to ban stock trading for politicians — members of Congress and the President alike — because our elections should be decided by working families, not self-serving interests.

We need a House majority that will defend election integrity, protect our democratic institutions, and put working people first. Taking back the House starts right here in MD-03, but we cannot counter the Trump Administration's bribery without your support.

name: Enoch for Congress
subject: I've heard "just one more chance" before
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
I spent years of my life as a counselor, sitting across from people trying to find the strength to walk away from someone who kept letting them down.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Hello Peter,

This week the Vice President of the United States went on a podcast, looked back at the last two years, and made his closing argument to you in six words: _"Give us another chance."_
I want you to sit with that phrase for a second.
I spent years of my life as a counselor, sitting across from people trying to find the strength to walk away from someone who kept letting them down. And I know that phrase. It's the one you hear from the partner who breaks the promise, runs up the bill, disappears when you need them — and then shows up at your door asking you to give them _just one more chance._ Not because anything has changed. Because they need something from you.
That's the pitch now. After two years of rising costs and broken promises, their argument isn't "look at everything we delivered for you." It's "please don't leave us." When the people in charge are reduced to begging you for another chance, they're telling you the truth about their record without meaning to.
And when begging didn't feel like enough, the President reached for the other move: he tried to pay you.
At the Republican convention in Dallas, and again at a rally just this week, Donald Trump promised a $5,000 check to every American — but _only if Republicans win in November._ Let me put that as plainly as I can: the President is dangling a $5,000 payment in front of you in exchange for your vote. There's a word for offering people money to vote a certain way, and it is not "dividend."
Here's the part they're counting on you to forget.
This is not the first check they've promised. Remember the "DOGE dividend" — $5,000 a household, they said? It never came. Remember the $2,000 "tariff rebate" he promised over and over, all last year? It never came either. Every single time, there's a shiny new number and a brand-new promise, and every single time the check gets lost in the mail. By the count of outlets like _Forbes_ , this $5,000 offer is at least the _fourth_ time he's promised Americans a check like this — and not one of them has ever actually been paid.
Beg for another chance. Promise money that never arrives. Repeat. That's the whole strategy.
I'm not writing to make you angry, though I understand if you are. I'm writing because the families of Ohio's 8th District deserve so much better than a party that only remembers we exist when it needs our vote. We deserve leaders who _deliver_ instead of _dangle_ — who fight to bring down the cost of groceries and health care and housing because it's the right thing to do, not because there's an election in eight weeks.
You cannot buy that kind of representation. But you can build it — together, right here.
And that's the honest truth about this campaign: we can't be bought, and we don't have a billionaire's war chest. What we have is each other. [A contribution today — **$25, $50, $100, or whatever you can spare** — is how we answer a $5,000 bribe that will never be sent with something they can't buy at any price: real people showing up for one another.](https://us.list-manage.com/4HZXyEAFMXQ?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
Will you chip in right now and stand with us?

name: OnePA Team
subject: The 2030 Census just became a fight for power
body:
When they decide who counts, they decide who has power. | |
---
Peter, **Trump’s Census Bureau has proposed a rule that would let Republicans decide who counts in America.** The 2030 Census will lock in congressional seats, Electoral College votes, legislative maps, and federal resources for the next decade. This proposal would radically reshape the census and make many of us and people who live in our communities invisible, even though the Constitution states that representation must be apportioned according to the “whole number of persons in each State.” **The rule would exclude foreign citizens from the population used for House apportionment unless they are U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents.** That includes undocumented neighbors and many people living here lawfully, including students, visa holders, and people waiting on green cards. The Bureau also wants to count people only if tax records confirm their address, which would miss millions of working families, especially low-income households. **The proposal would also prohibit race and ethnicity questions, along with sexual orientation, on the questionnaire used to count the population.** Census race and ethnicity data is how we enforce civil rights protections, challenge maps that dilute Black and brown votes, and track disparities in our schools, hospitals, housing, and jobs. **The 14th Amendment requires representation to be apportioned according to the whole number of persons in each State. For every modern Census, including 2020, people were counted where they lived and slept most of the time. The Bureau is taking comments through October 13.** [**Tell the Census Bureau to withdraw this proposed rule and protect a complete, accurate, and fair 2030 Census.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39NmOvaZcBPP9JnPfijpf5tgEgMLjYXYVzAh-jTAT7WPQOUFhekclcmzsKA_jUhdUeKDo3PEQ04UA4blWMTJmnRctkw8xwVEp2cdr6nX3ZZgL_T3JkwkFYRbNdTrrjSPGEbkLjLnmnqTZUoVj8lBwgL75Are0DbzXG5-noYRsJWWIrzE1nb1Iolwa-uL3Ym2i_8wxAvvLw_43MA5URsK7OI3z6psiy8MkVczUJlKe-kWFB93HKOF58IJzqFISTUdT6J-7r61xwPNJRed4sq1fgM3K7cSRLV1bjzw1QgxBW-cPnlE22DmFGUPQGIg0G1W3jkrBhk_aarHOWyxLJyn8P-EPws1t05LA9gVhWDQINtLj7oJWijXtxunKiyOpf-9oGrzt0ldIulLbczedJ5GaV78F3sY1_t6gGJJayT1Oi4gIIXtVjf5C8COpL_kJli0dwht28_WgmOjNux9KYz7eUMhDtzzBBAnmHHes9tsWAGam2-fxP-2GzYMtZl3oOaDVI/4u7/yFK5ND1hQj2t5XmbZvyDmw/h0/h001.MDU8jTqjvXUDMiXt9Xvq9MUfEVL-Qtxfwi6r5XEijmU) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39NmOvaZcBPP9JnPfijpf5tgEgMLjYXYVzAh-jTAT7WPQOUFhekclcmzsKA_jUhdUeKDo3PEQ04UA4blWMTJmnRctkw8xwVEp2cdr6nX3ZZgL_T3JkwkFYRbNdTrrjSPGEbkLjLnmnqTZUoVj8lBwgL75Are0DbzXG5-noYRsJWWIrzE1nb1Iolwa-uL3Ym2i_8wxAvvLw_43MA5URsK7OI5yIG-7HpBkoMJOr_uM1nsk-DySkk9KDt1tI9PmVDa7el1gFhD-Plfh07Y_i5KcFjbAS0gmuhoal8x6xGaryTRQUsTG6vvv52tRjpwUzhUZfSutEfQR14y0xVSRElL7CwnHBDFAq4tqG_OYw6jNNNRidmd_71szhkBN12819jXLItbyp1paK9OgSFeiUH9eFR9CijCwQj3aqXGJ-FcNRhQhtuAu5_00eyYKg76MSs4-tXxwocYFy74xm715nmA29pUnY25UNqd6SS1ieF5jDCc1KVS-0abw4IoDEjT_I8BDs/4u7/yFK5ND1hQj2t5XmbZvyDmw/h1/h001.XOZQitQjej1mJzLPdmFegFpLlyTdTQ_xX-naRbYXGdE)

clean_body: When they decide who counts, they decide who has power. | | Peter, Trump’s Census Bureau has proposed a rule that would let Republicans decide who counts in America. The 2030 Census will lock in congressional seats, Electoral College votes, legislative maps, and federal resources for the next decade. This proposal would radically reshape the census and make many of us and people who live in our communities invisible, even though the Constitution states that representation must be apportioned according to the “whole number of persons in each State.” The rule would exclude foreign citizens from the population used for House apportionment unless they are U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents. That includes undocumented neighbors and many people living here lawfully, including students, visa holders, and people waiting on green cards. The Bureau also wants to count people only if tax records confirm their address, which would miss millions of working families, especially low-income households. The proposal would also prohibit race and ethnicity questions, along with sexual orientation, on the questionnaire used to count the population. Census race and ethnicity data is how we enforce civil rights protections, challenge maps that dilute Black and brown votes, and track disparities in our schools, hospitals, housing, and jobs. The 14th Amendment requires representation to be apportioned according to the whole number of persons in each State. For every modern Census, including 2020, people were counted where they lived and slept most of the time. The Bureau is taking comments through October 13. | | Pennsylvania already knows that an undercount can cost us dearly. Our cities and towns are home to Black communities, immigrant families, students, and working people. If those neighbors disappear from the count, our communities lose representation and the resources that follow population. We organize because representation belongs to the people who live here. Black political power, immigrant communities, working families, and LGBTQ neighbors are part of this country. The Census happens once every ten years. Organized people can force this rule off the books if we show up in the official record. subject: The FBI wiretapped me. I’m not backing down.
body:
| | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139582453/647851529/-634730441?refcode=260920_suhas_fbi&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTRkMzMxMC1mZmI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TIRuXFnmrwl6A5lAYt39WgVArDQjsLO4Uq80_ZXE-QU=)
---
I was recently informed by the FBI and DOJ that as a part of their investigation into Virginia state Senator and President Pro Tempore Louise Lucas, law enforcement agencies intercepted my phone conversations with her.

This is deeply concerning — let me explain why.

Since re-taking office, Trump has turned the DOJ into his own personal law firm.

They have opened up politically-motivated investigations into multiple state attorneys general, the former FBI director, the former CIA director, and countless other perceived political enemies, resulting in multiple indictments. And now, they admit they have surveilled conversations by a sitting Member of Congress — who happens to be a Democrat, and happens to sit on the House Oversight Committee.

**[If the Trump administration thinks these actions will scare or stop me from holding them accountable, they are dead wrong. I am more determined than ever to deliver a Democratic majority to hold bad actors accountable and to fight for Virginians. If you’re with me, will you join the fight with a donation to my re-election campaign and Equal Opportunity Now today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139582454/647851530/-634730441?refcode=260920_suhas_fbi&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTRkMzMxMC1mZmI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TIRuXFnmrwl6A5lAYt39WgVArDQjsLO4Uq80_ZXE-QU=)**
---
[ _**HELP ME FIGHT BACK AGAINST MAGA EXTREMISM!**_ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139582456/647851531/-634730441?refcode=260920_suhas_fbi&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTRkMzMxMC1mZmI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TIRuXFnmrwl6A5lAYt39WgVArDQjsLO4Uq80_ZXE-QU=)
---
| | | The timing of this wiretap and investigation is extremely suspicious. The tap took place between March and May, which was at the peak of the campaign push for Virginia’s redistricting referendum. This was also the same time period the Oversight Committee was calling on Pam Bondi to testify on the Epstein investigation.

This should concern anyone who believes in an independent Department of Justice that serves the American people — not one president — and anyone who believes we need a Congress that will hold this administration accountable instead of turning a blind eye.

subject: Coming to you with a heartfelt request

#
Hi, it’s Ken Burns. I am coming to you with a heartfelt request:
[**If you, like me, are deeply concerned about the future of our democracy and the rising tide of extremism, I urge you to join me in supporting Eugene Vindman’s reelection campaign for Congress today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260920-2-acq-870-p1-b8&refcode2=1957_2947551_joSJ0V&akid=1957%2E2947551%2EjoSJ0V)
As a filmmaker, my life’s work has been dedicated to capturing pivotal moments in American history — moments that have shaped our nation’s identity and spirit. I’ve documented our country navigating through its darkest hours and emerging stronger, understanding the profound consequences of these moments.
Throughout my career, I’ve seen our nation evolve in countless ways, but one constant remains: our democracy, the cornerstone of our republic, and the essence of what it means to be American.
Yet, at this very moment, our democracy faces an unprecedented challenge — a critical inflection point. We are at a juncture where our very rights and freedoms are threatened.
The stakes have never been higher, Peter. Our democracy stands at a crossroads — and this moment requires leaders who will unify our country in defense of the very fabric of our nation — no matter political party or affiliation. Eugene Vindman is one of those leaders.
I first met Eugene and Alex nearly 40 years ago, when I interviewed the Vindman twins and their grandmother for a documentary about the meaning of the Statue of Liberty. It was shortly after they fled Soviet Ukraine and sought refuge in the United States as children.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260920-2-acq-870-p1-b8&refcode2=1957_2947551_joSJ0V&akid=1957%2E2947551%2EjoSJ0V)
Their father came to the U.S. with $759 in his pocket, three children, and a dream of giving them a better life. And through hard work and perseverance, they achieved just that.
Eugene’s story is the embodiment of the American dream. He is a Ukrainian immigrant, an Army Veteran, and a lifelong defender of our democracy. He’s a good man — one who has devoted himself to defending our country with courage, selflessness, and resilience, even at his own expense.
Eugene has never failed to hold our leaders accountable — no matter their party. And as a result, our government is baselessly retaliating against him and targeting him in a federal investigation aiming to remove him from Congress.
We need to keep people like Eugene in Congress — leaders who continue to stand up for our democracy and represent the true spirit of America — and this investigation puts that at risk.
So, Peter, it would mean a lot to me if you could support his reelection campaign today to help keep him fighting for us in the People’s House.
[**Can you please donate $3, or whatever you can afford, to Eugene Vindman’s campaign for Congress today? I am asking because it is critical.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260920-2-acq-870-p1-b8&refcode2=1957_2947551_joSJ0V&akid=1957%2E2947551%2EjoSJ0V)

Peter - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this.

_We just won._ Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff.

Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state.

**And it worked.**

But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes.

**Annie Andrews has $4.1 million.**

She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot.

Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise.

clean_body: | Peter - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this. We just won. Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff. Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state. And it worked. But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot. Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise. The general election is November 3. That sounds far off. It isn't. It's less than 70 days away. Every week between now and then, Annie Andrews's campaign will be on television, in your mailbox, and on your phone - funded by liberal donors who wanted to defeat Lindsey and now, defeat me. We have to be able to answer that, and right now, we can't. My opponent has a $4 million head start. To catch up and rebuild, I need not only patriots who were with us over the last six weeks, but folks who are stepping up for the first time. Don't let the most radical candidate South Carolina Democrats have nominated buy this seat. Thank you for standing with me, Darline Graham United States Senator P.S. Every donor, whether it's your first donation or you've been with us since day one, tells the Hollywood donors watching this race that South Carolina is still behind us after two hard-fought elections. | | Paid for by Darline Graham Majority Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Darline for Senate, Fund for America's Future, Security is Strength PAC, and NRSC. 228 S. #
Hi there,
Swing Left is dedicated to keeping this community updated on the high-stakes swing races we are supporting across the country. Today, we’re taking a closer look at Michigan’s 4th Congressional District, where **Democratic State Senator Sean McCann** has a prime opportunity to flip a key seat blue and help win back the U.S. House majority.
The national environment is firmly on Democrats’ side, with likely voters favoring Democratic candidates over Republicans by nearly 9 percentage points according to a recent [New York Times/Siena poll](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2371?t=1&akid=2837%2E1562180%2EMKCuaW). That national surge is translating on the ground in MI-04. While there isn’t recent polling in this race, a June poll showed Sean McCann pulling ahead with a 48% to 45% lead over 16-year Republican incumbent Bill Huizenga, driven by a massive 19-point lead among Independent voters.
In 2025, Huizenga voted for Trump’s Big Beautiful Bill, a move that earned him up to $50,000 in tax breaks this year while gutting health care and food assistance in his district.
Now, in a district Donald Trump previously carried, nearly 6 in 10 voters disapprove of Trump’s job performance. And independent political analysts like _Sabato’s_ _Crystal Ball, Inside Elections,_ and _Cook Political Report_ have all shifted the ratings for MI-04 in Democrats' direction.

**Heiber** came to the U.S. from Colombia when he was seven months old.
Growing up undocumented, he watched opportunities slip away — scholarships, college, a driver's license. His mother had to return to Colombia when he was 14. He hasn't seen her in person in 19 years.
Then DACA opened a door. Heiber earned his degree, took a job at an investment company, built a life with his wife, and stepped into leadership at his church. Now, he's thriving.
But DACA renews in two-year increments, and that comes at a price. DACA is temporary. Companies won't invest in his education because of his status. Jobs he's qualified for stay out of reach. The future he's building could disappear at any moment.
Heiber says it simply: _"I don't want handouts. I just want an opportunity to contribute without fear of losing everything."_
**Eriberto** knows what temporary costs, too. He's called Massachusetts home for 26 years and built a career helping students succeed. But then his work authorization expired while his case sat pending. He had the job. He had an employer who wanted him. He lost the ability to work anyway. Everything he worked for was suddenly out of reach.
**This is the consequence of congressional inaction. And that's why our work to deliver citizenship is more urgent than ever.**

clean_body: Two people, two stories, and ten days until the end of our quarter. | | | Peter, in just a moment, I'll share two stories. | | Heiber came to the U.S. from Colombia when he was seven months old. Growing up undocumented, he watched opportunities slip away — scholarships, college, a driver's license. His mother had to return to Colombia when he was 14. He hasn't seen her in person in 19 years. Then DACA opened a door. Heiber earned his degree, took a job at an investment company, built a life with his wife, and stepped into leadership at his church. Now, he's thriving. But DACA renews in two-year increments, and that comes at a price. DACA is temporary. Companies won't invest in his education because of his status. Jobs he's qualified for stay out of reach. The future he's building could disappear at any moment. Heiber says it simply: "I don't want handouts. I just want an opportunity to contribute without fear of losing everything." Eriberto knows what temporary costs, too. He's called Massachusetts home for 26 years and built a career helping students succeed. But then his work authorization expired while his case sat pending. He had the job. He had an employer who wanted him. He lost the ability to work anyway. Everything he worked for was suddenly out of reach. This is the consequence of congressional inaction. And that's why our work to deliver citizenship is more urgent than ever. clean_body: Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in.
